lineRunBulk.title: Line Run Bulk Registration
lineRunBulk.s1D: Download the template file from the link below.
lineRunBulk.s2D1: Open the csv format of Excel etc. with editable software and fill the information.
lineRunBulk.s2D2: For Round, select one from the following and enter.
lineRunBulk.s2D3: For Team name, select one from the following and enter.
lineRunBulk.s2D4: For Map name, select one from the following and enter.
lineRunBulk.s2D5: For Field name, select one from the following and enter.
lineRunBulk.s2D6: Enter start time in the following format
lineRunBulk.s3D: After selecting the file, please check the contents displayed below.
lineRunBulk.generatorInfo1: This generator is intended to create an initial competition schedule and bulk registration without CSV.
lineRunBulk.generatorInfo2: There are two modes for schedule generation:
lineRunBulk.generatorInfo3: 1. Teams are rotated through normalization groups (maps) so that every team should receive each selected map exactly once. Every field hosts a different map.
lineRunBulk.generatorInfo4: 2. All fields host the same map and normalization group in each round. All teams compete on the same map in each round and fields are just for parallel execution.
lineRunBulk.generatorInfo5: The number of selected rounds must match the number of selected maps.
lineRunBulk.generatorInfo7: Fields only define how many runs can take place in parallel, as they are physical locations.
lineRunBulk.generatorInfo8: Teams, rounds, fields and maps are preselected automatically and can be adjusted before generation.
lineRunBulk.generatorInfo9: Always verify the generated schedule before importing it into the competition!
lineRunBulk.generatorExampleText: 8 rounds + 8 maps = 8 normalization groups. The number of fields only affects throughput and schedule duration.
lineRunBulk.generatorModeFixedDesc1: Fixed Map Mode: Each round corresponds to exactly one map and normalization group. Teams stay on the same challenge for the entire round and fields are only used as parallel execution locations.
lineRunBulk.generatorModeFixedDesc2: Fields need to be physically rebuilt after every round.
lineRunBulk.generatorModeScrambledDesc: Scrambled Mode: Maps are assigned to normalization groups hosted on different fields. Teams rotate between fields and normalization groups across rounds so that each team visits every selected map exactly once.
lineRunBulk.generatorDisclaimerText: The generated schedule is based on the selected configuration and available teams. Organizers are responsible for reviewing the final schedule, map assignments, field assignments, timing and normalization groups before importing runs into the competition.
